Best third-placed team coming from one of groups X/Y/Z/... (resolved via best_thirds_allocation)

best_thirds_allocation._note: Full official FIFA Annex C lookup: all 495 combinations of the 8 qualifying third-placed groups -> which third feeds each of the 8 host R32 matches (74,77,79,80,81,82,85,87). Parsed deterministically from the raw Wikipedia template wikitext (no model transcription). KEY = the 8 qualifying group letters sorted alphabetically (e.g. 'ABCDEFGH'). VALUE.assign maps R32 match_id -> the 3rd-place group ('3X') that fills the third-place slot in that match. VALUE.option_no is FIFA's combination index (1..495). Column->match mapping used: 1A->79, 1B->85, 1D->81, 1E->74, 1G->82, 1I->77, 1K->87, 1L->80.
best_thirds_allocation.source_primary: FIFA World Cup 2026 Regulations, Annex C (495 combinations): https://digitalhub.fifa.com/m/636f5c9c6f29771f/original/FWC2026_regulations_EN.pdf
